new.ngStep: ngStep(ngState(P,ngLtError(E,O,11),Rho,Fs,Es)) is exactly ngState(P,ngLtError(E,O,11),Rho,Fs,Es); no event appended.
new.ngAdvance: ngAdvance at bound0 returns exact input; any positive bound on ngLtError(E,O,11) returns the identical complete state; no event appended.
new.ngObserve: Stops upon ngTerminal(ngLtError(E,O,11)) and returns the complete tape without invoking ngStep on that boundary and without a terminal-stutter state row.
new.scope: Error-control observation boundary only, not P1 Rejected publication.

new.ngLtPrimitiveValue(E,O,V): Always nonterminal. Bool V steps to ngReturn(V) with ngLtPrimitiveReturned event; non-Bool V steps to OutsideModel using declared reason token.
new.ngLtPrimitiveError(E,O,Code): Always nonterminal. Code11 steps to terminal ngLtError(E,O,11) with ngLtPrimitiveFailed event; any other code steps to OutsideModel using declared reason token.
new.ngLtError(E,O,Code) when Code != 11: Nonterminal; one ngStep goes to OutsideModel using declared reason token.
